data.name: Snigdha
data.gender_notes: Snigdha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Snigdha is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning soft, gentle, and pure. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'snigdh', which means 'soft' and 'sweet'. The name is often used for girls in Hindu communities and is associated with the qualities of softness, purity, and delicacy. The name Snigdha carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, pure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Snigdha usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Snigdha is a spiritual name that represents the inner softness and purity of the soul. It is a reminder to live in a gentle and compassionate way, and to cultivate inner peace and harmony.
data.etymology: Snigdha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle, pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Snigdha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
